U26.title: Upwork In-Demand Skills 2026
U26.signal: Contracted US-origin work; 2025 freelancer earnings. Paid category demand, not a new seller's odds or exact offer validation.

UJ.title: Upwork automation job listings
UJ.signal: Public automation requests visible; individual availability, budgets and fit must be rechecked. Postings are not completed purchases.

AA.title: AgencyAnalytics pricing
AA.signal: Displayed USD20 per client/month billed annually; vendor says 7,000+ agencies. Established reporting competition.

MX.title: Matrixify pricing
MX.signal: Plans displayed $20/$50/$200 per 30 days; normalization service must solve work outside the import app.

MR.title: Matrixify Shopify listing
MR.signal: Priced merchant app and user reviews; evidence of an operating category, not guaranteed service demand.

CK.title: Checkly pricing
CK.signal: Paid browser/API monitoring; quotas and overages. No claim all products are included in a single headline price.

PA.title: Parseur pricing
PA.signal: 20 pages/month free; table displays $49/month for 100 pages and $129 for 1,000. Pricing in USD; verify selected tier.

GD.title: itch.io Godot assets
GD.signal: Paid and free Godot assets with price listings; no verified unit sales or seller profits.

SH.title: itch.io shader assets
SH.signal: Multiple paid shader/VFX listings and extensive free competition; supply and pricing evidence only.

IN.title: Insycle pricing
IN.signal: Commercial CRM deduplication/normalization category. Vendor pricing, not independent willingness-to-pay for our service.

WP.title: WP Buffs care plans
WP.signal: Commercial WordPress maintenance plans; ongoing responsibility makes this not passive.

DM.title: dmarcian pricing
DM.signal: Commercial email-authentication monitoring category; restrict service to authorized domains and legitimate mail.

PD.title: PandaDoc pricing
PD.signal: Paid document/proposal workflow software; do not offer regulated legal advice.

MK.title: Make pricing
MK.signal: Automation infrastructure and metered plans; implementation is an opportunity hypothesis, not platform resale permission.

N8.title: n8n pricing
N8.signal: Commercial workflow software and published plans; underlying workflows can support consulting.

N8L.title: n8n Sustainable Use License
N8L.signal: Consulting/customer-owned workflows differ from white-label hosted resale; confirm license for embedding.

SP.title: Shopify app distribution revenue share
SP.signal: Eligibility-dependent developer revenue share; app launch/review and processing fees apply.

SE.title: Shopify developer ecosystem
SE.signal: Shopify reports over US$1.3B developer payouts in prior year; aggregate ecosystem spending, not typical app income.

BL.title: Superhive marketplace
BL.signal: Commercial Blender addon market. Listing prices and marketplace access are not verified individual sales.

FA.title: Fab publishing
FA.signal: Digital asset distribution; publisher review and rights requirements. Distribution evidence only.

NO.title: Notion paid template marketplace
NO.signal: Paid template checkout and creator requirements; marketplace availability is not proof of sales.

ET.title: Etsy fees
ET.signal: Listing/transaction fees plus additional processing, regional and advertising fees where applicable.

EC.title: Etsy creativity standards
EC.signal: Originality/design, production-partner and AI disclosure requirements constrain digital and POD products.

VI.title: Visualping pricing
VI.signal: Paid change-monitoring plans; free alerts and paid competition reduce generic monitor differentiation.

BA.title: Bannerbear API pricing
BA.signal: USD49/month published entry paid tier; template image/document rendering category.

CC.title: CloudConvert pricing
CC.signal: Usage-based file conversion credits; commodity competition for generic conversion.

ME.title: MERX procurement opportunities
ME.signal: Existing procurement discovery business. Use licensed official feeds; no permission to resell MERX content inferred.

IC.title: Intercom pricing
IC.signal: Commercial support and AI-support market; unit costs and human escalation matter.

CA.title: Cal.com pricing and workflows
CA.signal: Free/paid scheduling and workflow features; prefer implementation over another generic scheduler.

PF.title: Printful pricing
PF.signal: On-demand fulfillment infrastructure, not evidence a particular design sells; fulfillment/shipping costs remain.

HA.title: HubSpot affiliate program
HA.signal: Affiliate distribution exists; approval, terms, attribution and audience acquisition remain constraints.

AD.title: Adobe Stock contributor royalties
AD.signal: Royalty distribution for accepted stock assets; low per-license economics possible; no sales forecast.

CH.title: Chrome Web Store policies
CH.signal: Extension distribution and user-data policies; approval and permission requirements, not demand evidence.

ST.title: Stripe Canada pricing
ST.signal: Domestic cards 2.9% + CAD0.30; Billing pay-as-you-go 0.7%; foreign/FX and other fees may apply.

UF.title: Upwork freelancer fees
UF.signal: Published contract fee 0%-15%; actual fee shown before proposal/contract. Do not assume universal 10%.

UC.title: Upwork Connects
UC.signal: Connects USD0.15 each; proposal cost varies; $0 plan cannot rely on unlimited free proposals.

IT.title: itch.io payments
IT.signal: Creator-selected platform share; default example 10% plus processing; payouts/withholding and payment mode matter.

LS.title: Lemon Squeezy pricing
LS.signal: Base 5% + US$0.50, with edge-case surcharges; merchant of record for approved products.

GM.title: Gumroad pricing
GM.signal: Published direct 10% + $0.50; Discover 30%; confirm all transaction charges for selected checkout.

CR.title: CRTC CASL FAQ
CR.signal: Consent, identification and unsubscribe; public addresses are not blanket permission; international and DM coverage.

TX.title: CRA GST/HST registration
TX.signal: Small-supplier rules generally CAD30,000 worldwide taxable supplies; single-quarter and four-quarter tests differ.

PR.title: Privacy Commissioner outsourcing
PR.signal: PIPEDA privacy/accountability considerations for outsourced data processing.

CW.title: Cloudflare Workers pricing
CW.signal: Metered serverless runtime; compute/storage/queues have separate limits and costs.

GH.title: GitHub Actions scheduled events
GH.signal: Schedules can delay/drop under load; use Actions for CI, not promised precise uptime monitoring.

WH.title: Stripe webhook integration
WH.signal: Verify signatures, tolerate duplicate/reordered events and acknowledge quickly.

PO.title: Stripe payouts
PO.signal: First payouts and settlement may lag sale; account/country-specific restrictions apply.

OA.title: OpenAI ChatGPT/API billing
OA.signal: ChatGPT and API billing are separate; plan business API expenses independently.
